item.title: [+2] Rupee falls 12 paise to 94.50 against US dollar amid elevated crude oil prices
item.description:
Signal: a weaker rupee. 1 report from Mid-Day. Mixed: 1 report points the other way. Turn: earlier readings (23 Oct) pointed the other way.

IT services: tailwind (+2) — IT exporters earn more in rupees

Why it matters: A weaker rupee raises the cost of oil and other imports and imported inflation, but lifts IT and pharma exporters' rupee earnings.

Market gauges: Rupee −2, Inflation outlook −1, Foreign investor flows −1

Confidence: low · horizon: weeks
